description: This is a PHP source file for a web-based configuration page that allows users to edit port forwarding rules, including IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, port ranges, and service types. It incorporates server-side PHP code to generate dynamic content and client-side JavaScript (jQuery) for form validation and interactivity.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Parses an IPv6 address string into an array of its segments, handling compressed notation (::).

methods.name: IsBlank
methods.description: Checks if form inputs with a specific ID prefix are blank, excluding certain fields.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Concatenates values from input fields with a specific ID prefix to form a full address string, separated by a specified separator.

methods.name: isIp6AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv6 address input is required based on form inputs.

methods.name: isIp4AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv4 address input is required based on form inputs.
